Avatar light ring, rear glow, glow intensity and animation toggles, respecting reduced motion.

Native SVG Add plus with explicit high-contrast stroke in light/dark themes; coordinated restrained blue/lilac/rose/mint aurora for search and Add.
Consistent minimal native SVG sun/moon controls on customer and administrator headers with readable colors; no icon-font dependency.
